control_failures.control_label: benching, battering or shoring of an excavation
inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: loss of containment at DZ-9201 during shift handover

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control EXCAVATION_SUPPORT: the benching, battering or shoring of an excavation was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control GROUND_CONDITION_INSPECTION: the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SLOPE_MONITORING_RESPONSE: the response to slope monitoring alarms was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters on DZ-9201 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in designing and controlling excavations, specifically working near an unsupported edge. DZ-9201 (earthmoving fleet) is in service for loading and dozing. The task proceeded during shift handover while the benching, battering or shoring of an excavation was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 5 February 2011 an incident occurred on DZ-9201 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during shift handover, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
